title: Intent retires its release driver, preflight scripts and hook build path into the core
objective:
Intent, after the sweep (design.md section 7; dialog section 6): the release driver `bin/.devbin/cmd/build.d/release` retires into the core (`release.verbs` gains `cut`; `derived:` carries the schema bless, the lock refresh, `agents sync`, `claude upgrade --apply`, `sync --to-disk` and the pair build; a gate for the live daemon); `bin/.devbin/preflight-linux.sh` and `cmd/shared/preflight.lib` retire into `release.legs`; `cmd/prepush` loses its preflight cover and clone-and-build paths; `cmd/brew` retires into the built-in formula and `cmd/macos`'s publish half into the built-in; `macos prepare` stays as a shadow until the built-in stages more than one app; `.github/workflows/linux-release.yml` fires on `candidate/`, `tests.yml` and `rust.yml` lose their tag triggers; the five hand post-tag commands stop; `.github/workflows/README.md`, `intent/docs/releasing.md`. Serves AC-4.3.
 Note from WP06a (2026-10-31): the built-in `macos publish` refuses a stage with no commit record, so Intent's shadow `macos prepare` must write the same record (`<stage>/commit`, HEAD's full sha) or retire into the built-in.


Record (vc, 2026-10-31): Intent's intent#ST0091 is the one place this work is written and claimed (WP-01 the cut through the core with Intent's own release.gates for 0481's re-run, the contract and reference checks, the provenance check and the daemon gate; WP-02 the kovacs leg and prepush, frozen remotes staying; WP-03 the tap and macOS publish through the built-ins, prepare as the shadow writing <stage>/commit; WP-04 the workflows on candidate/ and the docs, its AC-04.3 hv's first cut through the core against the 3.2.8 baseline); this package points at it. Nothing in it starts before the sweep; the vendor commit is WP09's. Intent issue 0665 (from Gtools' finding): at lint exempts a Completed thread from the literal-id rule, so a test deleted inside a surviving file reads as conforming.
